column3: Like, somehow, your presence was stopping me from being the best I could.
I felt like the brightest candle in the world being put next to an industrial lightbulb.
And here we are;
You vanish for ten years and now I'm the second- best trainer in Reborn.
Given the league's reputation, maybe in the whole world.
And even knowing how completely outclassed I am by Shelly, it didn't feel the same as when it was you.
And yet?
It's felt hollow; like something was missing.
I'm glad you're back.
HARDY: You know I really don't like that you two just,
Hang out now?
HARDY: Oh, perfect, company to save me from this nightmare.
\PN, Elias. Hey.
\PN, Taka. Hey.
Good to see you both back.
TITANIA: Welcome back.
FERN: Sup.
TAKA: Hey, uh...
TITANIA: Speak up.
And stop looking down at your shoes.
It's been long enough that you should've grown a spine by now.
TAKA: That's...
TITANIA: Ha, you're way too highly strung.
I know even though it's been 10 years for me, it's been like, what,
Not even a day for you since you two disappeared?
Growing out of old habits takes time.
You'll get there, I'm just giving you shit.
TAKA: ...Thanks.
I think?
And... thanks again for at the Water Treatment Center all those years ago.
Even if I didn't listen to you at the time, I...
You actually tried to look out for me.
...Even if you were a lot scarier about it back then.
FERN: She's still plenty scary, just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
She's not the only one that's changed though;
Notice anything else?
HARDY: Not this again...
TAKA: I mean, you've all changed your hair?
FERN: Yeah, and we look great.
But I was talking about mister rockstar.
He doesn't try and fake his voice to sound like what he thinks is 'cool' anymore.
Yanno, like, y'all've gotta remember he'd say rockin' stuff 'n shit, mate?
HARDY: For the last time.
I never sounded like that.
TITANIA: Fern, we've spoken about this.
You're a serious member of the Reborn League now.
You need to conduct yourself properly.
Doing a bad impression of one of the region's most famous musicians is unbecoming.
HARDY: ...
TITANIA: Ahem.
You need to give things your all now.
Make it a GOOD impression.
Short sentences.
Chill vibes.
Don't overthink, mate.
Just go with the flow, yanno?
Feel the music, and rock on.
Maybe roll out a pun or two just to lay it on real thick, aye?
HARDY: I cannot overstate how much I hate this.
TAKA: ...I'm glad you all seem to be getting along.
You said something about Fern being a serious member of the League?
Is he a Gym Leader now?
HARDY: If only.
Somehow, standing in front of me is half of this region's Elite Four.
TAKA: Oh, wow uh...
Congratulations.
I mean, I've seen you both be pretty incredible in battle so...
...Yeah...
FERN: Hardy's still pouting that we both surpassed him.
You'd think he'd be content being an actual rockstar now.
TITANIA: Guess you don't need to fake sounding successful when you actually are, huh?
HARDY: You know even when you two compliment me, it still feels mean.
I was actually happy for you both, you know.
You worked real hard.
Sis, you've always been terrifying in a battle.
And Fern, I mean, took you a while to figure out how to make people wanna be around you.
The bit I'm 'pouting' about,
Is that you both got the job, and so you ended up hanging out.
And now I have to deal with a united front mocking me.
...But nah, I'm happy for you guys.
And all the teasing aside, it is nice to actually be able to talk to either of you,
Y'know, without being at each other's throats.
FERN: Likewise.
Elite Four... It's pretty cool stuff, really.
TITANIA: Shelly's a good kid.
I tried to take her under my wing, but she rubbed off on me as much as I did on her.
So I jumped at the chance to be one of her Elite Four.
TAKA: Oh, yeah.
The influence was pretty obvious when we met her.
Walking through her room at the league, I was pretty certain it was gonna be you.
TITANIA: The swords were her idea!
HARDY: Shelly is a great Champion.
No offense to you, obviously, \PN.
But anyone that can mellow out these two is hard to beat in my book.
TAKA: I'm glad you guys all seem to be doing well.
And congrats on both making Elite Four.
And for your music Hardy...
Yanno, mate?
HARDY: ...I remember back when I wished my sister was more friendly.
If only I knew.
The blissful ignorance of those days...
ELIAS: Ah, hello.
TITANIA: Hey, you.
I got a good look at your room in the League after you vanished.
It was incredibly intricate.
Beautiful too; must've taken a lot of work to get it to your specifications.
ELIAS: That's...
Yes, actually!
I do love good architecture, so I made sure--
TITANIA: I'm Elite Four now.
They gave me your room.
I tore it all down.
ELIAS: I...
TITANIA: They just put everything for it in storage.
But that look on your face was pretty cathartic.
That feels like as much payback as I can get with my Aegislash at home.
Either of you two want a turn?
HARDY: Nah, I'm good.
I already got Bennett back years ago, going again would feel like a repeat.
FERN: I feel like I'm probably on the wrong side of all this to want payback against him.
TITANIA: Suit yourselves.
ELIAS: ...You know, when we first entered the Champion's room at the league, I thought it was you.
And I feared for my life.
So I suppose I've gotten off easy.
Perhaps I had no reason to be so scared.
FERN: She's still plenty scary, it's just like she said,
She just didn't bring her stabbing Aegislash to the party.
She's not the only one that's changed though; notice anything else?
ELIAS: It's been ten years, you all look remarkably different.
And I can't say I knew any of you very well beforehand.
FERN: Yeah, we all look different, sure.
Look great, in fact.
ELIAS: You all seem to be very close friends.
What is this about Fern being a serious member of the League?
ELIAS: Goodness, Fern as well?
I am certainly aware of your battle prowess from even ten years ago.
Reborn seems to be in very good hands, with such a strong Elite Four and Champion.
The bit I'm 'pouting' about.
Is that you both got the job, and so ended up hanging out.
HARDY: Yeah, Shelly is a great Champion.
ELIAS: She certainly appears to be doing very well, from what we saw.
HARDY: Yeah, things are going pretty well.
I'm sure they'll go just as great back in your time, too.
TITANIA: Y'know, I thought I'd quit battling altogether after everything with Meteor.
Maybe in another life I would've.
But I'm pretty damn great at it, and Shelly is worth supporting.
I digress.
Good luck back in your time.
Even if you're only ten percent as good of a Champion as Shelly has turned out to be?
Then Reborn is in good hands.
HARDY: I know I'm speaking to the person that just had an adventure through time.
But my life has been pretty hectic.
Music gigs, traveling around the world...
It's pretty cool stuff.
Helps that Aya's always with me the whole time.
...Things are pretty great, really.
But we all missed you, I'm glad you made it back.
ADRIENN: You know, when Victoria stopped helping out at the Grand Hall to focus on Apophyll,
While we were still dealing with the New World aftermath?
I thought I was going to drown in paperwork.
But everyone helped out, and these days I can actually even relax!
Seriously, though, are you okay?
Being flung into the future is pretty rough, I get it.
I used to wish I could go back...
Sometimes I still do.
But mostly, I'm glad that I've made a life for myself here.
I'm happy you get to go back to your time, though.
Treasure the next ten years you get to spend with everyone.
And, like I said, be the best Champion Reborn has ever seen.
ARCLIGHT: Hey, great to see you two!
They're out of tea, and the brownies are terrible.
But this café is still pretty cool.
And you even get to witness something marvelous, something you'd never see back in your own time:
Xyr Majesty, Monarch of Monotony, Archon of Administration.
Adrienn sitting down and taking a break.
ADRIENN: Arc, come on.
I was never that bad, I took breaks.
I mean, when people made me, at least...
TAKA: Seems like you're a lot less stressed out, now...
ADRIENN: Well, having such a brilliant and proactive Champion helps.
I'm sure I'd be just as relaxed after ten years of \PN as Champion, too.
ARCLIGHT: Helps that you stopped trying to do about twenty people's jobs at once, too, and learned to actually delegate.
ADRIENN: I can't exactly take credit for that with you right here.
You two saw how we were coordinating the response to all the New World messes,
Based out of the Nightclub, yeah?
Turns out, Arclight here has a real knack for that sort of thing.
ARCLIGHT: Yeah, I guess I've done all right.
Realized I could do a lot of good out there.
Got into a lot of community organizing, eventually took over a lot of Adrienn's job responsibilities.
So xe could actually rest from time to time.
You wouldn't believe how much more willing people are to talk to you about public policy or whatever.
When you're that cool guy from the TV or radio.
TAKA: That's wonderful...
It sounds like you're making a real difference out there.
...Though I think you were before, too.
I always liked listening to you on the radio and stuff.
Made me feel better about being stuck somewhere I didn't wanna be.
ADRIENN: Be careful, the praise might go to his head.
ARCLIGHT: Hey, quiet. I'm used to praise from fans; if that was gonna grow my ego, it would've caused problems years ago.
Happy I could help though.
Pass that on; go back to your time and try to help people out too.
Just having someone to talk to can help a lot of people.
TAKA: Thanks... Both of you, really.
For everything.
I mean, we've heard a lot about what an amazing Champion Shelly is.
But it's obvious for things to be as good as they are, she must have a great team supporting her too.
ADRIENN: We do our best.
Even if there are some issues still.
Every time we work on a major project, it feels like we spend just as much time on something silly.
Usually the something silly is finding another Vulpix room.
I swear she stashed them everywhere...
ARCLIGHT: Hey, I'm not complaining.
If we're stumbling on secret rooms hidden away by former Champions?
I'd take rooms of Vulpix plushes over anything Lin did any day of the week.
ADRIENN: Can't argue with that.
Hey, \PN.
Shelly's done an amazing job as Champion.
Go back to your time and do an even better job.
If I chose the wrong person, that'll make me look really bad!
TAKA: With people like you working on the administrative side...
I think Reborn is in good hands whoever is Champion.
ELIAS: Good to see you as well.
It's been a while, Adrienn.
ADRIENN: Been even longer for me.
Glad you're all right though.
Things got pretty crazy with everything that happened, but I know most people were just,
Trying to do what they thought was best.
ELIAS: I appreciate that, although I feel I made mistakes at every turn.
Clearly that doesn't hold true for you.
You look quite so relaxed compared to then, things must be going well.
ELIAS: I can't say I watched enough television or radio to be familiar with you.
Beyond your work fighting Meteor and dealing with the aftermath.
But it sounds like you've been helping people for a long time.
Probably more than just the last ten years.
Nice of you to say, though.
You try to do the same thing back in your time, all right?
Everything with Meteor was messy, sure.
And I think a lot of people will be way less happy with you than they are here with ten years to move on.
But if you respect people doing good, then follow their lead and do the same.
ELIAS: Wise words, of course.
I can only do my best.
As you clearly have, too.
After all, we've heard a lot about what a talented Champion Shelly is.
But it's obvious that for things to be as good as they are, she must have a highly skilled team supporting her, too.
ELIAS: You know, I suspect that with people like you working on the administrative side of things?
Reborn will be in good hands whoever is Champion.
ADRIENN: Thanks.
I appreciate the faith.
And you too.
I'm sure you can make a difference, just like Arc said.
I'll see you two around.
ARCLIGHT: Yeah, see you later.
Enjoy the party;
Shelly went all out, especially given how last minute this was.
ARCLIGHT: Who'd have thought that letting you all run...
I mean, basically just disaster response, out of my club,
Would lead to all of this.
Sorry you ended up getting flung through time for all that,
Hope it wasn't too long for you, at least.
I'm sure you'll do a great job with it when you get back, too.
Oh, and watch out for some of the Legendaries when you get back.
I heard that dealing with a few of them got real weird.
CAIN: Well, hey there, you~
Miss me so much you wanted to chat again?
I can't blame you, hard to look away from someone as cute as me.
Y'know, I really missed you.
Shelly is a great person, and a great Champion.
Maybe even better than you would've been? I'll probably never know.
...But you were my friend, and you were there for so much.
You can hardly blame me for wishing you were still about.
Now you're here again, I guess all there is to say is...
I hope your next ten years are as happy and fun as the last ten years were for all of us.
Give 'em hell, \PN.
Make sure everyone knows that the day you got your starter at the Grand Hall?
A truly magnificent trainer started their journey in Reborn proper.
...I guess you and Victoria did too, huh?
...Joking aside again, I'm sure you'll do great.
Good luck out there.
CAIN: Hey hey hey~
Here I am talking to my favorite sister.
And my favorite time travelers show up too?
Is today my lucky day, or what?
AYA: Cain, everything's a favorite when you're that specific.
CAIN: That's the point.
It's about letting everyone share in the love~
AYA: Hey \PN, hey Taka.
Good to see you both back safe.
TAKA: Cain, Aya... Hey.
You both look well, nice to see you too.
CAIN: Well doesn't even begin to cover it!
You're talking to one of the region's most famous musicians.
As well as her charming, brilliant, and all around very hot brother.
AYA: Modest as always, Cain.
But yeah, mine and Hardy's band is doing pretty great.
Gotta be doing something right if I've got so many fans, right?
I mean, even if we didn't have all the fans, I'd say we're going pretty well.
Our music kicks ass.
TAKA: If the people that make it like it so much, it must be good.
It's made with love and care and all that stuff...
CAIN: That's the attitude!
If you give everything your all, things should work out fine.
Or at least you'll have enjoyed it if they don't!
AYA: Truer words have never been spoken by the king of giving their all to things when you really don't need to.
In fact, you two will get a kick out of this.
A few years back, a government position opened up in Reborn City, some inspector job or other that nobody really wanted.
Kind of job you're voted in for but the last person had been doing it for like forty years or whatever,
And apparently did an awful job that whole time,
So nobody wanted to clean up that mess.
So only one candidate ran and won by default.
Anyway, the result is that now Madame Meganium holds a governmental position in Reborn City.
Cain here saw that and remembered that an election for the Mayor of the newly cleaned up Byxbysion Ward was coming up.
And thought it would be very funny if he could enter a Garbodor in the running for that job.
CAIN: Hey, Bigglesworth isn't just 'a Garbodor', he's a friend!
He can talk, he even battles properly.
TAKA: Don't all Pokémon, like...
Just kind of already know how to battle?
CAIN: Yeah but I mean, using Pokéballs and stuff.
Like a trainer rather than a Pokémon.
He can talk, so it's not that much of a stretch.
TAKA: That's... interesting.
AYA: Anyway, even something silly like this, Cain decides to dedicate all his time and attention to.
And actually ends up running a very good and compelling political campaign on no budget.
So, long story short, Mayor Bigglesworth has a record high approval rating?
And last year Byxbysion overtook Lapis in opinion polls as the nicest ward to live in?
CAIN: Yeah and I guess I work in politics now.
It's pretty neat.
AYA: He's being modest, he's incredibly good at it.
CAIN: Oh yeah?
Well YOU are a very good musician and a lovely sister.
So there.
AYA: I know all that, I'm great.
AYA: Hey, ask Cain what Bigglesworth's campaign slogan was.
TAKA: Uh...
Hey, Cain, what was the campaign slogan?
CAIN: I'm glad you asked!

With so many piles of garbage running for office,
map_0900#710		Don't vote for a Garbage Can't. 
map_0900#711		Vote for a Garbage Can.
map_0900#712		Vote Bigglesworth.
TAKA: That... is very catchy.
CAIN: I'm glad you think so, it's my job now!
...Although it isn't without difficulty.
Shelly doesn't know it started as a joke, and it's gone so far I don't have the heart to tell her.
She thinks I just had some kind of brilliant insight that Bigglesworth would be so good at the job.
So she's asked me to find good potential candidates for other positions...
Like, I'm happy to help, but I feel like that was more a fluke than anything else...
TAKA: I mean, either way, it sounds like you've both found things you're really good at?
And enjoy?
That's pretty cool.
AYA: Yeah, the broody edgy poison girl turned out to be a great musician.
